title: Molecular Dynamics and Docking Reveal Enhanced Binding of HPV16 E6 Asian American Variants To non-phosphorylated DLG1.
authors: Araujo-Arcos, Lilian Esmeralda; Montano, Sarita; Bello-Rios, Ciresthel; Garibay-Cerdenares, Olga Lilia; Leyva-Vazquez, Marco Antonio; Illades-Aguiar, Berenice
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接和MD研究HPV16 E6变异体与DLG1 PDZ结构域的结合差异，属蛋白-蛋白互作而非TF-DNA体系，但方法（对接/MD）可迁移至蛋白-DNA界面建模，故给5分。
abstract: The E6 oncoprotein from Human Papillomavirus type 16 (HPV16) interacts with PDZ-domain proteins such as DLG1, a key regulator of cell polarity and proliferation. In this study, we used an in silico approach to investigate the predicted interactions between the reference E6 protein and five variants using a domain-focused model of DLG1 in phosphorylated and non-phosphorylated states. Protein-protein docking analyses revealed variant-dependent differences in predicted binding affinity. Notably, the E-C188/G350 and AAa variants showed stronger predicted binding to the non-phosphorylated form of DLG1. In contrast, all variants exhibited reduced predicted affinity for the phosphorylated form, while the reference E6 displayed comparatively higher predicted binding. These observations suggest a preferential predicted interaction of E6 variants with the cytoplasmic, non-phosphorylated pool of DLG1, whereas the reference E6 may preferentially interact with phosphorylated DLG1. Overall, our findings provide predictive structural insights into the differential behavior of HPV16 E6 variants in their interaction with DLG1 and establish a framework for future experimental validation.
abstract_zh: 人乳头瘤病毒16型（HPV16）的E6癌蛋白与PDZ结构域蛋白（如DLG1）相互作用，DLG1是细胞极性和增殖的关键调控因子。在本研究中，我们采用计算机模拟方法，基于DLG1的域聚焦模型，在磷酸化和非磷酸化状态下，研究了参考E6蛋白与五种变体之间的预测相互作用。蛋白质-蛋白质对接分析揭示了预测结合亲和力的变体依赖性差异。值得注意的是，E-C188/G350和AAa变体对DLG1非磷酸化形式表现出更强的预测结合能力。相比之下，所有变体对磷酸化形式的预测亲和力均降低，而参考E6则表现出相对较高的预测结合能力。这些观察结果表明，E6变体优先与细胞质中的非磷酸化DLG1池发生预测性相互作用，而参考E6可能优先与磷酸化DLG1相互作用。总体而言，我们的发现为HPV16 E6变体与DLG1相互作用的差异行为提供了预测性结构见解，并为未来的实验验证建立了框架。
